senses.definition: In an efficient or effective manner; with powerful effect.
senses.example: The nightclubs generally provide liquor (at a price), pretty girls who are clad diaphanously but extremely effectively, a tiny space in which to dance [...] and food[.]

senses.definition: Essentially, in effect, for all practical purposes.
senses.example: On paper, the answer seems to be yes, but, effectively, the answer is no.
